Alex (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — capturing timeline Qs on API / Console / Optimize. @Priya can you confirm the shifts?
Priya (Product): Sure. Short list: 1) API rate-limit beta timing, 2) Console RBAC + rollout gating, 3) Optimize recommendations GA ETA.
Jared (Eng): API rate-limit beta slipped ~1 week due to flaky e2e tests. New tentative beta flip: 2026-04-12. CC @Sam.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Confirmed — infra can reserve extra capacity the week of 2026-04-05 for canaries. :thumbsup:
Priya (Product): Console RBAC MVP is in QA. Rollout gating depends on metrics retention policy (30d vs 90d). Need call by Friday.
Tasha (DevEx): Recommend 30-day default + 90-day as paid opt-in to reduce storage impact for early customers.
Priya (Product): Agreed. Plan: 30-day default, 90-day opt-in. Owners: @Tasha for docs, @Marta for billing UI.
Jared (Eng): Optimize perf knobs PoC (auto-batching suggestions + quant presets) is done. We plan to surface recommendations in Optimize v1.0, target GA 2026-05-03.
Alex (CEO): Will that GA include Dedicated or will Dedicated come later? Need to call out compatibility.
Priya (Product): GA will include limited Dedicated presets; full Dedicated support scheduled for 1.1 (~6 weeks after GA).
Sam (Eng-Infra): Note: Dedicated kernel matrix changes require a migration step. We'll provide a migration script and compatibility notes.
reliability-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-04-10 -> 2026-04-15 for API beta (no incidents expected).
Priya (Product): Action items: 1) Priya to publish updated roadmap by Monday, 2) Jared/Sam to confirm canary capacity and final date, 3) Tasha/Marta to update docs & billing before Console rollout.
Alex (CEO): Thanks everyone. If anyone has blockers, drop them here or DM me. :rocket:
